links.comparator_used: Base Huozi 3.5 / GLM-4-9B-Chat models used off the shelf without fine-tuning on counseling data
links.outcome: Empathic expression and empathy identification scores (automatic evaluation); expert-rated empathic attunement
links.effect: YuanChat-Huozi3.5 empathic expression 0.57 to 0.68; empathy identification 0.54 to 0.59; expert empathic attunement 1.279 vs 0.327 for base Huozi3.5 (mean difference 0.952, 95% CI 0.746-1.152)
links.quote: Fine-tuning increased YuanChat-Huozi3.5's empathic expression score from 0.57 to 0.68; empathy identification score increased from 0.54 to 0.59.

links.comparator_used: Same YuanChat model without E-URIAL (no predicted labels and no retrieved labeled exemplars)
links.outcome: Empathy identification, empathic expression and perceived helpfulness scores
links.effect: With E-URIAL and 3 retrieved exemplars: empathy identification 0.69 vs 0.59, empathic expression 0.79 vs 0.68, perceived helpfulness 0.74 vs 0.61
links.quote: When E-URIAL was applied with 3 retrieved exemplars, YuanChat-Huozi3.5 achieved an empathy identification score of 0.69 versus 0.59 without E-URIAL, an empathic expression score of 0.79 versus 0.68, and a perceived helpfulness score of 0.74 versus 0.61.
